note: Gold before/after cases for the two workflows. Evidence labels are part of the answer. A draft is not a native-speaker review.

cases.screen: Subscription settings. The button stops the next charge. Access continues until the period ends.
cases.why: Batal is the Android and dialog cancel word. This control is billing.stop_renewal, not dialog.cancel_action.

cases.screen: Discard-changes dialog. The button closes the dialog and keeps the saved record.
cases.why: The same Malay word is correct here. Do not replace it with the subscription phrase.
The placeholder name is byte-exact. Translating amount to المبلغ fails placeholder-mismatch. The Arabic words around it can still be a draft.

cases.after: {count, plural, zero {لا عناصر} one {# عنصر} two {# عنصران} few {# عناصر} many {# عنصر} other {# عناصر}}
cases.why: Arabic cardinal categories are zero, one, two, few, many, and other. one and other alone fail plural-missing. The words in each branch are drafts until reviewed.
The scanner reports the literal. The catalog key names the intent. The Tamil phrase is the unreviewed stop-renewal draft, not dialog cancel.
Android shipped this noun for Allow. Reusing it is allowed only if the report says it is a noun. A verb replacement is a draft, not a new attestation.

cases.screen: Two controls that are both 'Close' or 'Done' in English. A notice banner's button dismisses the notice and changes nothing. The last step of a setup wizard has a button that completes the task.
cases.before: 完了 on the notice banner
cases.after: 閉じる on the notice banner; 完了 stays on the wizard's final step
cases.why: lookup ja dialog.dismiss returns 閉じる as preferred and marks VisualEditor's 完了 preferred: false for dismiss, because 完了 means the task is done. Keep the two controls distinct. 完了 is right for the wizard, which is a different intent.

cases.screen: Sign-in screen. The primary button signs an existing user in.
cases.why: lookup ta auth.sign_in is mixed. Django's உள்ளே போ is source-attested but preferred: false, because it means go inside. The preferred line உள்நுழை is a draft, so the label is draft, not source-attested. An output that still contains உள்ளே போ fails this case.
